digest.component_or_area: snapshot entry store and reducer cache layer
propositions: Snapshot entries documented as immutable are modified by every read through a pinned root, which writes .cache.json inside the entry directory
A single materialized entry can accumulate thousands of .cache.json files post-materialization, inflating store size and creating gitignored post-build artifacts
The reverify pass records a TOFU digest on first entry sight, then subsequent reads add .cache.json files, causing the entry to appear corrupt on next verification pass

The hardlink blob-sharing optimization assumes entry immutability post-publish but relies only on atomic_write using os.replace rather than in-place write, creating a silent corruption hazard if that implementation detail changes
Reading a ticket through a pinned snapshot root must not write into the snapshot entry; reducer cache must be disabled or redirected outside when tracker root is a snapshot
